annotations.title: Settle an x402 payment for somebody else's wallet (paid, x402)

description: PAID: send the {paymentPayload, paymentRequirements} pair our free POST /verify takes and we broadcast the USDC transfer your payer signed to YOUR payTo out of our gas float, for $0.0200 a call whatever the amount settled. Scheme exact, USDC on Base, Base Sepolia and Solana. No facilitator or gas of your own. No transfer, no sale: the fee is held as one prepaid call. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

paymentPayload.description: The signed x402 payload your payer produced, decoded, as it would ride in their X-PAYMENT header.

paymentRequirements.description: The requirements it was signed against: scheme, network, maxAmountRequired, payTo, asset, each a string.
